mentions.name: buzz
mentions.description: This programming language has been in development for four years and currently focuses on tooling: a language server protocol (LSP) implementation, a debug adapter (DAP), and a code formatter. Fuzzing with AFL++ has been set up and has uncovered a number of bugs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been working on my programming language https://github.com/buzz-language/buzz for 4 years now (with some down periods).
Currently mainly working on the tooling: LSP, DAP and formatter.
Also managed to get fuzzing working with AFL++ and found a bunch of bugs with it.
